title: Jacobi symbol for an odd numerator
statement: For natural numbers $A,N$, if both are odd, then $(A/N)=(-1)^{ oldsymbol{1}_{A\equiv 3\ (\mathrm{mod}\ 4),\ N\equiv 3\ (\mathrm{mod}\ 4)}}(N\bmod A/A)$, where the prefactor is $-1$ when both are congruent to $3$ modulo $4$, and $1$ otherwise.
